title: Porch Paradise
meta_description: Porch Paradise is a 4BR Seacrest retreat with a private pool, screened porch, beach access, \& bikes---perfect for your laid-back 30A coastal escape.
description_expanded:
ABOUT THE HOME: Welcome to Porch Paradise in the heart of Seacrest, between Rosemary and Watersound. This 4 bedroom, 3 bathroom, tranquil coastal home with tons of outdoor entertainment is the perfect place for your next 30A beach getaway. Spend your days playing by the shore, relaxing in the private pool, or entertaining in a full screened porch cheering on your favorite game, or riding bikes exploring 30A. After your day in the sun, enjoy your evening cocktail on a large porch as you watch the sun away, or around the comfy sofa cheering on your favorite team.

ABOUT THE AREA: Porch Paradise is located in the coastal town of Seacrest that sits between Seagrove and Alys Beaches along 30A. You have easy access to all that 30A has to offer, but with the secluded feeling this area provides. Seacrest is perfect for nature lovers seeking an unspoiled retreat and in an uncrowded environment. Enjoy canoeing, kayaking, swimming and more in this quaint town with Old Florida charm. There are many options for recreation as well as dining in communities nearby like Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach and the Big Chill (formerly the Hub).

BEACH ACCESS: Seacrest Drive Beach Access which is deeded private access. the nearest public beach is Deer Lake State Park which has bathrooms, showers and ample parking.

ACCOMMODATIONS:
Bedroom 1 -- Queen/Queen Bunk, Shared Full Bathroom -- 1st Floor
Bedroom 2 -- King Bed Ensuite Shower -- 2nd Floor
Bedroom 3 -- Queen Bed Shared Full Bathroom -- 2nd Floor
Bedroom 4 -- Queen Bed Shared Full Bathroom -- 2rd Floor

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• Wrap Around Porches
• Large Screened Porch w/Ping Pong, TV and Entertaining Opening up to the Pool
• Private Pool
• 2 adult bikes
• Beverage bar
• Full size washer and dryer
• Full linen package: bedding, bath \& beach towels
• Fully stocked kitchen

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- Please note: The first and second floors are not connected internally. Access to the first floor requires exiting the second floor and using the exterior stairs.
- Please note the backyard overlooks an active construction site, and guests may experience construction activity and noise during their stay.

Parking Details:
- Private parking for up to 4 cars.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
